GHA.note: Biometric verification for public services is a proposed amendment, not a service in operation.
A count of 18,955,360 registered is given but no population or share.
Registration of children aged 0-5 is mentioned but no number at birth.
Nothing on who operates, maintains or owns the system.
No public register keyed on the ID number stated.

facts.fact: The National Identification Authority reports 18,955,360 Ghanaians registered, 18,853,779 cards printed and 17,855,708 cards issued; ISO certification is only being initiated.

GHA.note: Mandatory biometric verification for public services is proposed only; no other system checking against the ID is stated.
